title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 17: Qualifies the Called

scenes.say: A school gym. A youth mentorship event. Ali takes the mic.
scenes.visual: a school gym with kids on bleachers and a man at a microphone, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: You ain't weak for crying. You strong for surviving.
scenes.visual: kids holding up phones to record a speaker, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I stopped chasing validation and started giving back.
scenes.visual: applause in a school gym, warm light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Church. Ali sits in the back. Quiet. Alone.
scenes.visual: a man sitting alone in the back pew of a church, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The pastor looks right at him.
scenes.visual: a pastor at a pulpit, stained glass light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: God don't just call the qualified. He qualifies the called.
scenes.visual: light streaming through stained glass, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I wasn't perfect. But I was chosen.
scenes.visual: a man bowing his head in a pew, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Outside, he helps kids paint a mural. Hoodlum Soldier. From War to Wisdom.
scenes.visual: kids painting a colorful mural on a brick wall, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: You really lived all that? Yeah. And I'm still living through it.
scenes.visual: a fist bump in front of a fresh mural, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Eighteen. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: paint cans and brushes in front of a mural, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 17 of 25: Qualifies the Called. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
